purpose: Source-bound executable official installed Gymnasium MountainCarContinuous-v0 reset/step/TimeLimit qualification; FAIL CLOSED if official package unavailable or file blob differs

contract.precondition: gymnasium module actually installed, gym.make registered env, env.unwrapped class belongs to official module, source file path resolves, entire file Git blob is exact pin; never write to or patch installed package
contract.on_absent: UNAVAILABLE nonzero exit, never PASS; optional isolated regression test SKIP only
contract.on_mismatch: FAIL_CLOSED source drift; never execute physics trial
contract.reset: compare 16 seeded official reset observations against independent P54 published_reset using at most absolute 5e-7; record exact source and seeds
contract.transitions: for 16 pinned source seeds test momentum and neutral actual actions up to 256 steps; compare observed next sensor absolute tolerance 5e-7, exact reward within 1e-9, exact terminated/truncated to P54 until time-limit; no future observations given to controller
contract.wrapper: on same official installed env 999 neutral actions from valid reset: no premature termination, final step triggers truncation, exact wrapper spec max_episode_steps=999; create fresh env for each audit
contract.negative: source mismatch and absent package both cannot produce PASS; wrong env id/class refused, no fallback to isolated upstream method
contract.evidence: source blob, official version, Python/pip environment, seed bounds, per policy trace sha256, max abs error, mismatch counts, time-limit, elapsed
contract.no_new_source_seeds_claim: Reuse P58 seeded engineering cases for parity; not new independent science
contract.test_metadata: do not claim full platform acceptance from local tests; Windows and Ubuntu mandatory separately
